lesson.intro: El pasado simple cuenta acciones terminadas; el pasado continuo describe lo que estaba en marcha en un momento del pasado. Juntos sirven para contar historias.
when: Pasado simple: acciones terminadas en un momento concreto (I called you at nine).
Pasado simple: una serie de acciones seguidas (He took his keys, opened the door and went in).
Pasado continuo: algo en progreso en un momento del pasado (At ten last night I was studying).
Pasado continuo: el 'fondo' de una historia (It was raining and people were running).
Los dos juntos: la acción larga (continuo) es interrumpida por una corta (simple): I was having dinner when the phone rang.
While suele ir con la acción larga (continuo); when suele ir con la acción corta (simple).

form.label: Pasado simple
items: Irregulares: go → went, see → saw, take → took
Pregunta: Did you see it? (did + infinitivo)

form.label: Pasado continuo
items: I / he / she / it was working

examples.en: I was having dinner when the phone rang.
examples.es: Estaba cenando cuando sonó el teléfono.

examples.en: While she was driving, it started to rain.
What were you doing at ten last night?
examples.es: ¿Qué estabas haciendo anoche a las diez?

examples.en: We didn't go out last weekend.
examples.es: No salimos el fin de semana pasado.

errors.why: Después de didn't el verbo va en infinitivo, no en pasado.
En preguntas con did, el verbo va en infinitivo.
Los verbos de estado no van en continuo tampoco en pasado.

lesson.tip: El imperfecto español ('estaba', 'hacía') muchas veces es pasado continuo, pero si describe un hábito ('jugaba al fútbol de pequeño') suele ser pasado simple o 'used to'.

checks.explain: Acción terminada en un momento pasado (last summer): pasado simple.

checks.prompt: They ___ football when it started to rain.
checks.explain: Acción larga interrumpida, sujeto plural: were playing.
Pregunta en pasado simple: Did + infinitivo.

practice.prompt: I ___ TV when the lights went out.
practice.explain: Acción en progreso interrumpida: I was watching.

answers: didn't go

practice.prompt: What ___ (you / do) at 8 o'clock yesterday evening?
answers: were you doing
practice.explain: Acción en progreso en un momento concreto del pasado.

practice.prompt: While I ___ dinner, I cut my finger.
practice.explain: While + acción larga: was cooking (I va con was).

answers: Did you see the match?

practice.sentence: She didn't went to school yesterday.
answers: She didn't go to school yesterday.
I was sleeping when the phone rang.
When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
practice.explain: Acción larga (was sleeping) interrumpida por una corta (rang).

practice.es: Estaba lloviendo cuando salimos del cine.
answers: It was raining when we left the cinema.
It was raining when we came out of the cinema.
It was raining when we left the movie theater.
practice.explain: Fondo en continuo (was raining) y acción puntual en simple (left).

practice.prompt: He ___ his keys, opened the door and went in.
practice.explain: Serie de acciones seguidas: pasado simple.

practice.prompt: They ___ (play) football when it started to rain.
answers: were playing

challenge.prompt: At 10 p.m. yesterday I ___ (study) for my exam.
answers: was studying
challenge.explain: En progreso en un momento concreto: was studying.

challenge.sentence: When I was walking home, I was seeing an accident.
answers: When I was walking home, I saw an accident.
I saw an accident when I was walking home.
challenge.explain: La acción corta que interrumpe va en pasado simple: saw.

answers: What were you doing when I called you?
What were you doing when I called?
What were you doing when I phoned you?
What were you doing when I rang you?
challenge.explain: 'Qué hacías' en ese momento = What were you doing.

challenge.prompt: I ___ (not / see) the sign because I was looking at my phone.
answers: didn't see

challenge.sentence: During my shower, the doorbell rang.
answers: while I was having
while I was taking
challenge.explain: While + pasado continuo para la acción larga.
